properties.name: app.rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Enables per-workspace SCIM API rate limiting.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.requests-per-second
properties.description: Sustained token refill rate per second for each workspace.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.burst
properties.description: Optional burst token capacity per workspace (defaults to ceil(requests-per-second), capped at 1000, when <= 0).

properties.name: app.rate-limit.wait-timeout
properties.description: Maximum wait duration to acquire a rate-limit token before returning HTTP 429.

properties.name: app.security.actuator.api-key
properties.description: Actuator API key used by the management filter.

properties.name: app.cleanup.workspace.enabled
properties.description: Enables scheduled workspace cleanup.

properties.name: app.cleanup.workspace.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for workspace cleanup.

properties.name: app.cleanup.workspace.zone
properties.description: Time zone used by the cleanup schedule.

properties.name: app.cleanup.workspace.stale-after
properties.description: Age threshold for stale workspaces.

properties.name: app.cleanup.request-logs.enabled
properties.description: Enables scheduled request log cleanup.

properties.name: app.cleanup.request-logs.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for request log cleanup schedule.

properties.name: app.cleanup.request-logs.zone
properties.description: Time zone used by request log cleanup schedule.

properties.name: app.cleanup.request-logs.max-count
properties.description: Maximum number of request logs to retain per workspace.

properties.name: app.cleanup.async-events.enabled
properties.description: Enables scheduled async event cleanup.

properties.name: app.cleanup.async-events.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for async event cleanup schedule.

properties.name: app.cleanup.async-events.zone
properties.description: Time zone used by async event cleanup schedule.

properties.name: app.cleanup.async-events.max-count
properties.description: Maximum number of terminal async events to retain per workspace.

properties.name: app.cleanup.async-events.stale-pending.enabled
properties.description: Enables scheduled stale-pending async event reaper.

properties.name: app.cleanup.async-events.stale-pending.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for stale-pending async event reaper schedule.

properties.name: app.cleanup.async-events.stale-pending-timeout
properties.description: Duration threshold after which PENDING async events are reaped to FAILED.
